## What's new in 0.3.0

### Horizons Panoramic Planner
- **Time-horizon planning embedded in Tasks.** Plan across **Inbox, Today, Week, Month, Quarter, Year, Decade, and Life** in one unified panoramic board (`Tasks → Horizons`), complete with scale switchers, period navigation, inline quick-add, drag-and-drop promotion between horizons, past-period rollover with one-click move, slide-over task details, and quiet reflection prompts.
- **Tight cross-app integration.** Controlled by a single toggle in **Settings → Features → Horizons**:
  - **Tasks & Matrix:** Horizon tasks remain visible in Inbox and lists with compact badges (warm-tinted for past periods), current ISO-week goals appear in Next 7 Days, and tasks support horizon selection in the Date Picker, context menu, Task Detail header, and natural-language Quick Add (`this week`, `this month`, `this year`, `на этой неделе`, `в этом месяце`, `в этом году`, etc.).
  - **Calendar:** Draggable Week, Month, and Year goal banners appear at the top of Calendar views so you can drop any horizon goal straight onto a day.
  - **Things & Search:** Short-term horizons map naturally into **Anytime**, long-term goals into **Someday**, with quick horizon chips in the Things **When** picker and horizon badges in Global Search.

### Things View (Beta) & Life Clock
- **Things-style workspace (Beta).** Optional calm task workspace (**Settings → Features → Things View**) with Inbox, Today, This Evening, Upcoming, Anytime, Someday, Logbook, Areas, Projects, inline expandable task cards, Quick Move, and Things-style When & Deadline pickers.
- **Life Clock («Ход времени»).** New split-screen kinetic timeline view displaying live elapsed time, optional birth-date age readout, bilingual reflections, classic and Fern-theme palettes, and an immersive rail-free mode with adaptive low-power frame pacing.

### Plugins Ecosystem (Beta)
- **Sandboxed QuickJS-NG plugin runtime.** Install, enable, configure, and manage plugins in **Settings → Plugins** with Safe Mode toggling (no restart required), dedicated plugin sidebar views and settings pages, custom modals, search providers, command palette entries, task/reminder hooks, and OAuth 2.0 loopback authentication.
- **Developer SDK & security hardening.** Includes `@fern/sdk` TypeScript definitions and registry workflow tooling, plus hardened SVG sanitization, SSRF/HTTP egress checks, credential vaulting, and strict module isolation.

### End-to-End Encrypted Sync (Protocol v2) & Data Safety
- **E2EE device sync & upgraded `fern-server`.** Optional passphrase-based end-to-end encryption for tasks, notes, and attachments, sync protocol v2 with note conflict preservation, healthcheck endpoint, and `.files` attachment garbage collection.
- **Resilient local storage.** Automatic corrupt-database preservation and recovery on startup, auto-backup restore picker in **Settings → About**, diagnostic log bundle export, read-only archived lists, and Trash delete confirmations.

### Cross-Platform Parity, Performance & Visual Polish
- **macOS & Linux native parity.** Native tray icons, global hotkeys, OS reminder notifications, audio playback, and window lifecycle parity alongside Windows.
- **Snappier startup & runtime performance.** Lazy `DataVersion` invalidation across hidden views (eliminating redundant background SQLite reloads on every edit), background daily backups off the cold-startup path, fast startup `PRAGMA quick_check`, SQLite engine tuning (`temp_store = MEMORY`, 8 MiB page cache, zero-allocation static prepared queries, targeted indexes), and deduplicated Focus tray updates.
- **Smart Filters & UI polish.** Added **Status** (`To Do` / `In Progress`) filter conditions, aligned Horizons headers and rollover cards, fixed Calendar current-time dot clipping and hour-label collisions, localized Focus duration units (`h`/`m`, `ч`/`м`, `小时`/`分`), flicker-free instant Global Search, balanced Appearance theme swatches, and softer scrollbars.

## Bug fixes

- **Double-reload & concurrency fixes.** Fixed `TodoView` re-broadcasting `DataVersion` on external changes (preventing double reloads across views and a Quick Add ping-pong deadlock), hardened SQLite WAL migrations and repeating schedules, and eliminated all remaining production `.unwrap()` calls across the workspace.
- **Plugins, Things & Calendar fixes.** Hardened plugin host lifecycle, modal Escape handling, `HStack`/`VStack` text layout, OAuth loopback port defaults, Things modal shortcuts and drag-and-drop, Calendar default multi-day span (`3 days`), and faster decoupled workspace builds (`desktop_common` no longer depends on `assets` or `resvg`).
